event: Assigned tractor lost power on I-81 south of Wilkes-Barre before reaching shipper.
known_cargo_condition: Freight remains at vendor origin; no cargo exposure reported.
recovery_action: Replacement tractor and driver dispatched from Pittston terminal.
schedule_impact: The delayed recovery pickup displaces the planned linehaul sequence; dispatch recalculated the trip within driver hours-of-service limits and expects to miss the 10:00 HVDC appointment.
